title: Permit Issue Time on Ridgeline Installation Services Jobs
content:
The time the permit office takes to issue a permit for a Ridgeline Installation Services job sets the issue-time share of the permit handling fee.

**Clause.** Issue-time share of the permit handling fee: the issue time is the calendar days from the contract signing date to the date of the permit fee line; an issue time of more than the slow-issue days of 30 takes the slow-issue multiple of 1.2, an issue time of at most the quick-issue days of 7 takes the quick-issue share of 0.9, and any other issue time takes an issue-time share of 1.

The permit handling fee is multiplied by the issue-time share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the permit handling fee is rounded, the permit handling fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The contract signing date** is the date the agreement was signed, from the contract record.
- **The date of the permit fee line** is the date of the line on which the municipal permit fee was billed at cost; where more than one stands, the most recent one counts.

| Issue time | Issue-time share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 days | 0.9 |
| 8 to 30 days | 1 |
| 31 days or more | 1.2 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical agreement signed 2 March)

| Permit fee line dated | Issue time | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 9 March | 7 | 0.9 |
| 10 March | 8 | 1 |
| 1 April | 30 | 1 |
| 2 April | 31 | 1.2 |
